function: Distributed HGNN for UAV Tx/Rx beamforming and Tx power control, maximizing spectral efficiency under UL rate and DL latency limits; fuzzy-logic decoupling is not learned (p. 5-9).
system: Multi-cell full-duplex cellular-connected UAV network: BS 4x4 Tx and Rx UPAs, UAV 2x2 Tx and Rx UPAs, 5.8 GHz, 30 MHz, no RIS (p. 4, 11).
method: Heterogeneous GNN with MLP message, update and output blocks; one layer reusing previous-frame embedding plus pilot-broadcast interference sensing; unsupervised training, Adam, SE-plus-QoS-penalty loss (p. 9-12).
data_channel: Own simulator: random BS and UAV layouts in 1x1 km2, LoS-probability path loss, Rician fading correlated across frames; 10^4 training and 10^4 testing layouts (p. 4, 11-12).
test_conditions: Trained on layouts with K=8 UAVs; tested on layouts with K=4 to 12 UAVs; also swept UAV speed, CSI quality, SI coefficient, localization error (p. 12-14).
baselines: Non-learned: coupled and PL association with MRT/MRC, DC, PL-SCA (SCA optimization [17]); learned: PL-EHGNN (existing HGNN [32]); HD scheme in Fig. 13 (p. 11, 13-14).
metrics: Total SE, UL rate, DL latency, SI power at UAV, QoS outage rate, signaling overhead, FLOPs, running time (p. 11-14).
complexity: Proposed HGNN 8.2x10^7 FLOPs versus EHGNN 1.8x10^8 and SCA 4.6x10^8 at K=4 (Table X, p. 14); analytic FLOP expressions (p. 11); running time (Fig. 14, p. 14).
q1_support: p. 4: "is modeled as Rician fading:" with LoS probability and path loss following [26]; a custom simulator, with no 3GPP TR 38.901 or 38.811 model, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "Notably, despite being trained with K = 8, the" proposed HGNN generalizes to different network sizes; p. 12 trains with K = 8 UAVs and tests with varying K (Fig. 12, K = 4 to 12).
q3_support: p. 13: "51.20% higher SE than the PL-SCA and PL-EHGNN schemes," where PL-SCA is SCA optimization [17], non-learned, and PL-EHGNN the existing HGNN [32], learned (Table IV, p. 11); both compared on SE, rate and latency.
q4_support: p. 14: "When K = 4, the computation complexity comparison" of proposed HGNN, EHGNN and SCA in Table X gives 8.2x10^7, 1.8x10^8 and 4.6x10^8 FLOPs; running time is in Fig. 14.
q5_support: p. 11: "BSs are randomly deployed with a BS density of 20 BS/km2" and UAV locations are randomly generated, so data are self-simulated; no code or data link, and no public or measured dataset.
notes: Area 6 (aerial links, learned beam and power control) rather than 3. Only the HGNN is learned; the fuzzy-logic decoupling is not. PL-EHGNN is the existing HGNN of [32] applied to the same problem; if the reviewer reads it as a variant of the proposed method, q3 would be 0.
